posts.content: Excited to share that our team just shipped a major React 19 migration! Huge thanks to everyone who contributed. 🚀

Three lessons from leading product teams in 2026:

1. Ship smaller, learn faster
2. Talk to customers weekly
3. Celebrate wins publicly

What would you add?
Just published our new design system documentation. Link in comments!
Hiring alert: InnovateLabs is looking for senior engineers and engineering managers. DM me if interested!
Marketing tip: Your best content comes from customer conversations, not competitor analysis.
We raised our Series B! Grateful to our investors and team.
Published a new article on building ML pipelines with Python. Check it out!
Great panel discussion at ProductCon today on AI in product development.
Open roles this week: 15 engineering positions across SF, NYC, and remote. Let me know who I should talk to!
Weekend project: built a CLI tool for automating code reviews. Open sourcing soon.
Content strategy framework that actually works for B2B SaaS 👇
Kubernetes 1.30 is out. Here are the top 5 features for platform teams.
Accessibility isn't optional. Here's our checklist for every design review.
Q1 earnings analysis: fintech sector showing strong growth in payments.
Leadership lesson: hire for potential, not just pedigree.
Closed our biggest enterprise deal of the year! Team effort all the way.
New HR policies rolling out next month focused on flexible work arrangements.
Zero-trust security: a practical guide for mid-size companies.
PMP certification complete! Ready to take on larger programs.
Reposting great insights from our engineering team.
